study_identification.title: Linking Personalized Brain Atrophy to Schizophrenia Network and Treatment Response

study_characteristics.study_objective: Test whether individualized cortical thickness atrophy maps derived via normative modeling (age, sex-adjusted) in schizophrenia converge to a disorder-specific functional network and whether connectivity between personalized atrophy maps and rTMS targets explains variability in treatment response.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Connectivity between the personalized atrophy map and the rTMS target was correlated with treatment outcome (PANSS change) in the RCT subset; spatial convergence of atrophy networks with schizophrenia-related hubs was tested; disease-specificity compared against networks from non-psychiatric disorders.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Personalized atrophy maps are heterogeneous but converge functionally to a schizophrenia-related network; connectivity between atrophy maps and rTMS targets predicts symptom outcomes.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Using normative modeling (vertex-wise GLM adjusted for age and gender) on 797 HCs, patient-specific W-score maps of cortical thickness were derived for 91 schizophrenia patients. Atrophy networks derived from W-weighted seeds showed high convergence to medial prefrontal and other schizophrenia-relevant hubs (spin-test corrected). In a randomized rTMS subset (n=52), functional connectivity between personalized atrophy maps and the TPJ target was significantly associated with PANSS symptom improvement.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Single-center normative model limits generalizability; focus on schizophrenia only; rTMS findings based on inhibitory cTBS protocol; overlap of sparse atrophy maps vs denser atrophy networks not directly comparable.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Normative modeling here uses a simple vertex-wise GLM (age, gender) to compute W-scores; no explicit multi-site harmonization or advanced nuisance handling; manual FreeSurfer QC performed; rs-fMRI preprocessing via SPM12/AFNI.

general_notes.general_notes: Smoothing: 8 mm FWHM for CT; 4 mm FWHM for rs-fMRI. HCP-MMP atlas and spin tests used for spatial correlation inference. Atrophy network mapping implemented by converting surface W-maps to volume (mri_surf2vol) and computing group-level t-maps from 652 HC rs-fMRI connectomes.
